card.name: Inside interleukin and other split names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a name that is split into parts, most often the "in" of interleukin just before "-1" or "-2". It also fires on the middle of capitalized words like CLINICALLY and on pieces of foreign-script or transliterated names.

modes.label: interleukin before number
modes.description: The "in" ending interleukin right before a hyphen and a number.
modes.example: Concurrent administration of anakinra (an interleuk<<in>>-1 antagonist) and another TNF

modes.label: Capitalized split word
modes.description: The middle of an all-caps word such as CLINICALLY.
modes.example: WAY MANAGEMENT, AS CLIN<<IC>>ALLY INDICATED. Clostrid

modes.label: Foreign names
modes.description: A piece of a transliterated or non-Latin-script name or title.
modes.example: the Muft<<i>> of Istanbul, and Emrullah Hat
